title: February 2026 White Sands event and El Paso airspace closure
place_text: White Sands, New Mexico; El Paso, Texas

tellings.quote: what happened at White Sands in February of 2026?

plain: Something is said to have happened in February 2026 at White Sands, a military testing range in New Mexico, around the time the airspace over nearby El Paso, Texas was closed. Michels raises it only as a question, "what happened at White Sands in February of 2026?", which he puts to his guest Matthew Brown, described as a Pentagon whistleblower. Nothing more of the event is given.
